contentHtml:
Property management services in Morristown

Tenant placement

We market your Morristown rental across top listing platforms. Every applicant goes through income verification on the tenant’s share of the rent, a credit and rental history review, and background screening as New Jersey law allows.

Rent collection

Online rent collection with direct owner disbursements. Late fees enforced as the lease and NJ law allow. Full visibility in your owner portal.

Maintenance coordination

Maintenance requests received 24/7. Vendor network covering Morris County. Owners approve repairs above their stated threshold.

Financial reporting

Monthly owner statements and 24/7 portal access.

NJ compliance

PPM stays current on Morristown and statewide NJ landlord-tenant law — security deposits, habitability, lease requirements, and eviction procedures.

The Morristown rental market

Morristown pairs a historic, walkable downtown — the Green, restaurants, and offices — with direct NJ Transit Midtown Direct service to Penn Station, which makes it one of Morris County's most in-demand rental markets. Demand skews to professionals and commuters who want a town feel with a one-seat ride to Manhattan, supported by the county courthouse, Morristown Medical Center, and a strong office base.

Inventory ranges from luxury downtown apartments to converted historic homes and single-family rentals. Accurate pricing and tenant quality matter.
